$comment: Mission 1.70 §13, §16 and §18. Temporal preselection is the one gate both routes come close to passing.

COMMON_CRAWL.immutability_reason: individually addressable and not stated to be retained unchanged

HTTP_ARCHIVE.run_identifier: a monthly crawl date, rounded down to the first of the month
HTTP_ARCHIVE.immutability_reason: addressable by rounded date and not stated to be retained unchanged

windows_alignable_reason: Both publish periodic runs identified before any value is read, so a window could be named on each side in advance. What is not established is whether the two runs cover comparable periods: one is a monthly browser crawl beginning on a stated day, the other a crawl release whose period semantics are not documented.
why_this_gate_is_not_the_blocker: Temporal preselection is the requirement that killed Censys, LeakIX and Shodan, and both web routes satisfy its shape. The blocker here is population, one gate earlier.
